title.narrative: Strengthening STEM Systems for Innovation in Pacific SIDS

description.narrative: This initiative strengthens STEM systems in Pacific Small Island Developing States (SIDS) to drive innovation, resilience, and sustainable development. It enhances science education, research, and applied innovation to address challenges such as climate change, water security, and disaster risk. Key actions include strengthening STEM curricula, building research and innovation capacity, and supporting science, technology and innovation (STI) policy development. Through regional cooperation, partnerships, and knowledge sharing, the project promotes inclusive participation, particularly for youth and women. By advancing STEM for innovation, it enables Pacific SIDS to develop locally relevant solutions and transition towards knowledge-based, innovation-driven economies aligned with sustainable development goals.
